# Logo Fountain

> Friendly bespoke logo design for UK small businesses, sole traders and founder-led teams.

Logo Fountain is a UK-led logo design service offering fixed-price logo design packages from £349. The service focuses on hand-drawn logo concepts, practical brand assets, clear feedback, final logo files for web and print, and clear commercial usage rights.

## Core services

- Bespoke logo design for UK small businesses
- Hand-drawn logo concepts
- Logo refreshes for businesses that have outgrown their first mark
- Logo suites, lockups, favicons and launch assets
- Brand colour and typography guidance on selected packages

## Packages

- Essential: £349, one developed logo direction, one refinement round, essential files
- Professional: £795, two developed logo directions, two refinement rounds, logo suite and mini usage guidance
- Complete: £1,495, three developed logo directions, three refinement rounds, wider launch asset pack

## Trust and ownership

- Fixed pricing
- Secure Stripe checkout
- UK-led designer service
- Client portal for feedback and files
- Commercial usage rights on final delivery
